_comment: Canonical source of truth for every price on the platform (PRICING_SPEC.md §0). Money is integer kobo everywhere — Rule 1. Changing a price is a config deploy, not a code change — Rule 2. Bump `version` on every edit: subscriptions store the version they were sold under so existing subscribers are never repriced retroactively — Rule 4.

trial._comment: PRICING_SPEC.md §9. A PAID trial, deliberately: where payment friction is the real drop-off, charging ₦1,000 proves the card works and produces a live mandate before the real charge. Not a rung on the ladder — it is an entry point, so it lives outside `plans` and is excluded from the ladder invariants.
trial.name: 7-day trial
trial.blurb: Seven days of everything. The ₦1,000 comes off your first plan in full.
